title: charger
description: v0.1 device-model entity: a non-solar battery charger, regardless of vendor: an AC mains charger, or a DC-DC charger fed by the vehicle alternator or another DC source. Published under renewvan/charger/<id>/<property>. Solar controllers are the separate `solar` entity. Only `voltage_v` is required of every source; everything else is optional.

voltage_v.description: Voltage on the charger's battery (output) side.

current_a.description: Optional: current delivered to the battery. Positive = into the battery.

power_w.description: Optional: output power delivered to the battery, in watts.

input_voltage_v.description: Optional: voltage on the charger's input side (alternator/starter battery for a DC-DC charger, mains for an AC charger).

source.description: Optional: what feeds the charger. `unknown` is the forward-compat fallback.

charge_state.description: Optional: the charger's own charge stage. `unknown` is the forward-compat fallback for any code not in this enum.
